newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks bounce up at open, defy Dow.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks bounce up at open, defy Dow.

text.p: * Toronto stocks bounced higher at Tuesday's open in busy trading after being closed on Monday. * Most of 14 sub-indexes rose. * 10 million shares worth C$130 million traded.
Toronto's key stock market index opened firmer on Tuesday, bouncing back from Friday's losses amid stronger international markets on Monday when Toronto was closed for a public and market holiday.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's 300 Composite Index rose 17.79 points to 6868.93, defying New York's modest early losses.
"The market doesn't look bad today," said Montreal-based strategist Bill Ram.
The base metals sector, one of Toronto's most heavily weighted, helped push the market higher, Ram noted.
